freshmen.applyLabel: TSU College Admission Evaluation (TSU-CAE) online application
rules: Students are accepted regardless of age, sex, nationality, religious beliefs, socio-economic status or political affiliation.
You must have graduated from a recognized secondary school.
New freshmen are not accepted in the second semester or summer.
If you have already enrolled in any college subject, you apply as a transferee, not a freshman.
Students from vocational courses, or courses that don't lead to a degree, are admitted as beginning freshmen.
You pledge to follow the rules and regulations of TSU.
requirements: Qualify in the TSU College Admission Evaluation.
Meet the average grade requirement (GWA) set by TSU or by CHED.
Qualify in the physical or health examination.
